## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Affected surfaces

- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] Web storefront
- [ ] Commerce admin
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Database or migrations
- [ ] Documentation or CI

## Validation

List commands and their actual outcomes. State what was not run and why.

## Data, security, and rollout

- Does this change affect authentication, authorization, payments, migrations, production data, or external providers?
- If yes, describe the safety boundary, verification, and recovery plan.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one outcome and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests or documentation were updated where appropriate.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, production dumps, or signing material are included.
- [ ] Generated files and repository safeguards were reviewed.
- [ ] Known limitations are stated.
